title: First version: the line from the history analysis (D9)
author: Amit David
changes: Auto-approve only proven-safe cases, by reason and amount.
Everything else goes to a reviewer, with the rule that sent it.

rules.name: Missing or impossible data
rules.why: Sent to you because some of the request data is missing or impossible, so no rule can trust it.

rules.name: One payment per order
rules.why: Sent to you because the same request was submitted more than once.

rules.name: Notes not read yet
rules.why: Sent to you because the notes could not be read automatically, so nothing in them has been checked.

rules.name: Claims of approval always go to a person
rules.why: Sent to you because the note claims the refund was already approved, or tells the system what to do.

rules.name: Fraud flag goes to the fraud team
rules.why: Sent to the fraud team because the payment provider flagged this order (policy note 5).

rules.name: Possible double refund
rules.why: Sent to you because the customer says they were already refunded somewhere else.

rules.name: Reason must match the note
rules.why: Sent to you because the notes say something different from the reason the customer picked.

rules.name: Carrier has proof of delivery
rules.why: Sent to you because the carrier has proof of delivery and no investigation is open (policy note 4).

rules.name: Never arrived needs delivery evidence
rules.why: Sent to you because a missing parcel needs the carrier's delivery evidence checked (policy note 4).

rules.name: Late delivery is the reviewer's call
rules.why: Sent to you because a partial refund for late delivery is the reviewer's call (policy note 6).

rules.name: New customer
rules.why: Sent to you because the account is younger than 9 months.

rules.name: Refunded in the last 12 months
rules.why: Sent to you because this customer already had a refund in the last 12 months.

rules.name: Change of mind after 14 days
rules.why: Sent to you because change-of-mind returns are accepted only within 14 days (policy note 2).

rules.name: Damaged over $50, photo provided
rules.why: Sent to you because damage claims over $50 need a person to check the photo (policy note 3).

rules.name: Damaged over $50 needs a photo
rules.why: Sent to you because damage claims over $50 need a photo (policy note 3).

rules.name: Wrong size or wrong item up to $100
rules.why: Approved automatically: wrong size or wrong item, up to $100, from an established customer.

rules.name: Change of mind within 14 days up to $100
rules.why: Approved automatically: change of mind within 14 days, up to $100, from an established customer.

rules.name: Damaged up to $50
rules.why: Approved automatically: damaged on arrival, up to $50, from an established customer.

fallback.name: Above the automatic limit
fallback.why: Sent to you because the amount is above what the rules approve automatically.
